Purpose: Main HUD widget used during gameplay

PlayerListBox.Purpose: Container for dynamically generated player entries

Notes: Assign PlayerListEntryWidgetClass to a Blueprint subclass of SkaldPlayerListEntryWidget to fully control the appearance of each entry (fonts, layout, icons).
When no custom entry widget is provided the native HUD will fall back to spawning simple text blocks that list the player's display name, faction, and territory count.
